A specification's stable identifier

Source: R/spec_hash.R
spec_hash.Rd

Twelve hex characters of a SHA-256 over the specification's canonical JSON. Metadata (id, label, note, tags) and exclusion notes are excluded, so relabelling a specification does not change its identity, and any field still at its default is dropped before hashing, so adding a new field with a default leaves every existing hash unchanged. Field order never matters.

Usage

spec_hash(spec)

Arguments

spec

An sdid_spec().

Value

A 12-character string.

Examples

a <- sdid_spec(design = list(treat_time = 1989), label = "first name")
b <- sdid_spec(label = "second name", design = list(treat_time = 1989L))
identical(spec_hash(a), spec_hash(b))
#> [1] TRUE
